question: Does the human PI accept the durable P2-A02 audit clearance and authorize the ordered provenance audit to continue later with P2-A03, while keeping P2 open and unaccepted until P2-A00--P2-A11 are all audited_and_cleared?

options.summary: Accept P2-A02 clearance and permit a separately launched P2-A03 audit.
options.consequence: P2-A02 remains audited_and_cleared. P2 stays open and unaccepted; P2-A03 becomes launch-eligible but is not started by checkpoint resolution. P3, H5, protected execution, publication, and release remain inactive.

options.summary: Request another explicitly bounded P2-A02 disposition.
options.consequence: Keep P2 open and pause the queue. Any further P2-A02 mutation requires the human-specified bounded scope. P2-A03 and all successors remain unstarted.

options.summary: Defer continuation of the P2 provenance audit queue.
options.consequence: Retain the durable P2-A02 evidence and keep P2, P2-A03, P3, H5, protected execution, publication, and release inactive pending a later human decision.

recommendation: Option A. P2-A02 corrected every authoritative human-audit finding without changing production source, passed deterministic validation including 100% diagnostic statement and branch coverage, and dispositioned the sole targeted review in one consolidated correction pass. This recommendation concerns only P2-A02 clearance and later P2-A03 eligibility; it is not P2 human acceptance.
blocked_scope: P2-A03 launch or mutation; P2 closure or human acceptance; H5 or P3-P11 activation; scientific or external execution; publication; release.
safe_scope: Read-only inspection and deterministic replay of the durable P2-A02 source hash, three class-owned modules, ownership and migration records, evidence inventory, review disposition, completion and parent verification, queue state, and control-plane validators. Checkpoint resolution may record an unambiguous human choice but does not itself launch P2-A03.
human_response: Correct `ExternalExecutionResult` test evidence within `P2-A03`. Implement the bounded correction from the completed human audit, move `ExternalExecutionOutcome` to artifact ownership, keep `ExternalExecutionFailure` untouched, leave P2-A03 open, and commit and push only authorized changes after deterministic checks pass.
normalized_decision: A — accept durable P2-A02 clearance and authorize the explicitly bounded P2-A03 ExternalExecutionResult correction while P2 remains open and unaccepted
authorized_scope: Resume only the human-audited P2-A03 correction of test__ExternalExecutionResult.py; move the internal ExternalExecutionOutcome alias assertion to one convention-compliant artifact-owned module; update only required append-only P2-A03 ownership, migration, audit-progress, and evidence records; run the enumerated focused deterministic checks; then commit and push the authorized correction to origin/dev. ExternalExecutionFailure, production source, schemas, fixtures, dependencies, locks, successors, protected execution, publication, and release remain unauthorized.
resumption_status: P2-A03 resumed only for the explicitly bounded ExternalExecutionResult correction after this resolution boundary is validated, committed, and pushed; P2 remains open and unaccepted
